title: Lior and the Drop
premise: Edmund Thackeray, a disgraced intelligence analyst, receives a meeting invitation from his handler — who died a week ago. The invitation pulls him into an active operation to stop a staged 'accident' that will kill hundreds and bury a state secret. As Edmund races the clock with a rogue colleague named Lior, he discovers his own erased memories are the key to identifying the attackers. In the end, Edmund must choose between exposing the truth and preserving the fragile peace his old agency will kill to protect — and he chooses truth, at devastating personal cost.
about_author: Cyrus Eriksen is the pen name of a former policy researcher who spent a decade inside institutions he no longer discusses. He writes thrillers about ordinary people trapped in machinery designed to forget them.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Three years into obscurity, Edmund receives a calendar invite from his dead handler, Mara Voss, for tomorrow at 9 a.m. He assumes a cruel prank until the attachment contains codes only she knew. Emotional beat: dread curdling into compulsion — the pull of a life he swore was over.

chapters.title: Nine O'Clock
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. He goes to the meeting point: a shuttered transit depot. Instead of Mara, he finds Lior, a young operative claiming Mara sent them both, and evidence of surveillance on the building. Emotional beat: paranoia sharpening into focus as Edmund realizes the trap is also a lifeline.

chapters.title: What Mara Left
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Lior reveals Mara's final dead-drop: files describing an attack staged as an infrastructure accident in eleven days. Lior distrusts Edmund — three agencies fired him for cause. Emotional beat: wary alliance; two people bound by a dead woman's last order.

chapters.title: The Rewritten Rules
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Decoding the files, Edmund recognizes redaction patterns from his own terminated project twenty years ago — the one that ended his career. Someone is using his old work. Emotional beat: humiliation transmuting into purpose; his disgrace becomes expertise.

chapters.title: Accident, Scheduled
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Surveillance confirms the target: a rail junction where a 'signal failure' will derail a packed commuter train. Lior reports to their surviving contact and gets a chilling reply: stand down. Emotional beat: the first crack — obeying orders means letting it happen.

chapters.title: Ghost Protocol
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Edmund traces who could stage such an accident and finds a familiar signature: a unit officially disbanded, its members scattered or dead. One name survives — Director Hale, his former mentor. Emotional beat: betrayal anticipated but still wounding.

chapters.title: The Man Who Forgot
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV, flashback-heavy. Under pressure and sleeplessness, gaps in Edmund's memory surface: a night twenty years ago he cannot recall, which Mara witnessed. Emotional beat: fear that he may be complicit in what's coming — memory as unreliable terrain.

chapters.title: Contact
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Lior makes contact with a retired technician from the disbanded unit, who agrees to talk, then vanishes before the meeting. His apartment is professionally cleaned. Emotional beat: grief and terror; the clock is real and someone is erasing witnesses.

chapters.title: Hale's Door
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Edmund confronts Hale at a charity gala, probing under pleasantries. Hale warns him off with genuine warmth — and a veiled threat about the night Edmund can't remember. Emotional beat: seduction of the old hierarchy; duty whispering that obedience is safety.

chapters.title: Split
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Lior discovers Edmund met Hale and accuses him of playing both sides. A brutal argument ends with Lior walking out — and taking the decoded schedule. Emotional beat: love-against-duty tension ignites between the partners; trust fractures exactly when they need it most.

chapters.title: The Missing Night
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Following Mara's coded hints, Edmund reconstructs the forgotten night: he didn't fail his project — he refused to sign off on a false-flag plan, and his memory was chemically suppressed. Emotional beat: vindication and horror; he wasn't broken, he was edited.

chapters.title: Reunion by Force
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Lior is ambushed by the ghost unit and saved when Edmund, tracking the same lead, intervenes. They escape into the rail tunnels beneath the city. Emotional beat: reluctant reconciliation forged in gunfire; the partnership becomes something neither will name.

chapters.title: Mara's Voice
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. A delayed dead-man's-switch message from Mara plays: she faked her death to finish the investigation and left the final piece with Edmund's own suppressed memories. Emotional beat: mourning reframed — Mara trusted him with the ending all along.

chapters.title: Countdown
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. With four days left, they map the operation: the 'accident' covers removal of a witness being transported through the junction. Lior realizes the passenger list includes someone she loves. Emotional beat: stakes turn personal; survival now has a face.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Hale offers Edmund full reinstatement and restoration of his reputation — if he delivers Lior and walks away before the junction. Emotional beat: the price of survival made explicit; everything he lost, returned, for his silence.

chapters.title: Twenty Years of Rules
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV. Edmund weighs the offer against the man he became by following rules that kept getting rewritten. He burns the offer, tells Lior everything, and commits fully. Emotional beat: quiet catharsis; choosing the person over the institution.

chapters.title: Into the Junction
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Day of the attack. They infiltrate the signal control bunker disguised as maintenance contractors, racing to override the sabotage before rush hour. Emotional beat: controlled panic; competence as a form of courage.

chapters.title: Signal Failure
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. The override half-works: the train slows but doesn't stop, and the ghost unit locks down the bunker. Edmund stays behind to manually hold the junction while Lior evacuates the control room. Emotional beat: sacrifice crystallizing; duty finally aligned with love.

chapters.title: The Price
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. The train passes safely. Edmund is captured by Hale's men as the bunker burns behind him. Lior escapes with the evidence drive, screaming his name into the dark. Emotional beat: victory hollowed by loss; survival as a debt.

chapters.title: Hale's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Edmund's POV, captive. Hale explains the cold math: one staged accident prevents a war. Edmund answers with Mara's files proving the war was manufactured too. Emotional beat: moral clarity under duress; words as the last weapon.

chapters.title: Everything Louder Than Words
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Lior detonates the scandal publicly — every agency, every rewritten rule — forcing Hale's arrest before Edmund can be disappeared. She finds Edmund alive in custody, memory intact this time. Emotional beat: triumph earned through ruin; truth as rescue.

chapters.title: The Drop
chapters.summary: Shared POV, epilogue. Months later, Edmund and Lior live off-grid, delivering the full archive drop by drop. Edmund remembers everything now, including what it cost. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution — memory kept, price paid, love chosen over duty at last.
